opening.argument: The presenter tells viewers how to pay to get started, including by credit card or wire transfer, and directs them to use tokens to purchase slots in mining pools. He ties greater token holdings and mining participation to generating OneCoins and making “real big money,” while also presenting network building as an income opportunity. Together, those statements promote paid participation in a mining pool as a route to substantial returns. The profit amounts remain projections, not realized returns, so the evidence supports the claimed opportunity without establishing that those profits were actually achieved.
